user: Tell me 3 important facts about hospice
bot:
Here are 3 important facts about hospice:

1.  Hospice provides compassionate care at the end of life.
    REFERENCE LINK: [Source: Hospice.pdf, Page: 1](/library/Hospice.pdf#page=1)
2.  Hospice services are always open, with nurses and physicians available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
    REFERENCE LINK: [Source: Hospice.pdf, Page: 5](/library/Hospice.pdf#page=5)
3.  Your hospice team will provide all medical care and services needed to provide comfort and support related to the terminal illness and related conditions, including pain and symptom management, medications, medical supplies and equipment, and one year of bereavement support to surviving loved ones.
    REFERENCE LINK: [Source: Hospice.pdf, Page: 5](/library/Hospice.pdf#page=5)

Hospice should be considered an integral part of a patient's end-of-life experience, providing compassionate care at this stage of life. Hospice services also address the changes that occur as death approaches, which is the final stage of life, offering ideas for care and comfort. Furthermore, hospice social workers and chaplains can assist with important conversations and decisions that need to be made at the end of life.
